development.nordwerk_a: NordWerk Demo fixture seed 20260928: the 12 rolling cross-validation origins only; its holdout (already seen: 64.2%) is excluded
development.uci_retail: UCI Online Retail II weekly v2 (50 products chosen on training-period data): the 12 rolling cross-validation origins only; its holdout is kept for the public-data evaluation

test.nordwerk_b: a NEW NordWerk realisation, seed 20261015 (synthetic): all cross-validation and holdout origins
test.bike_daily: UCI Bike Sharing daily total rentals (real): all cross-validation and holdout origins; never evaluated before

study.selection: among methods whose development coverage is within 0.75..0.85 on BOTH development datasets, the lowest mean scaled interval score (mean of the two datasets); if none qualifies, NO method is selected and intervals stay unvalidated
study.validation: the selected method is 'validated on these datasets' only if its test coverage is within 0.75..0.85 on BOTH test datasets; otherwise intervals are labelled not validated and nothing may rely on them
study.interval_score: Gneiting-Raftery interval score: (hi - lo) + (2/alpha)(lo - y)+ + (2/alpha)(y - hi)+, alpha = 0.2, divided by the series scale (in-sample one-step naive MAE on data before the evaluation window)
study.not_allowed: no change of rules, methods, datasets or thresholds after seeing development or test results
